doc.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: First recordings: Montego Joe, Mongo and Tones For Joan's Bones
summary: Panken and Corea sort out which recording was his first.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Let’s take you, then, from Mongo Santamaria to your first recordings. I think the first one was called Is, if I’m not mistaken...
No, that was the second one.
Let’s take you through the sequence of events that got you there. Was your first appearance on record that Montego Joe recording with Eddie Gomez and Milford...
That’s what I’m told. Either that, or the Mongo Santamaria that I did, called Go, Mongo.
